findings.evidence: Basic.lean:244-290 contains only `covarianceForm_def`, `covarianceForm_comm`, `covarianceForm_self`, `variance_def`, `variance_add`, `variance_nonneg`, `variance_eq_zero_iff`, `comp_variance`. Mathlib/Probability/Moments/CovarianceBilin.lean:50 bundles the same object as a continuous bilinear map; Mathlib/Probability/Moments/Variance.lean:216 has `variance_smul`.
findings.fix: Either define `covarianceForm` via `Matrix.toLinearMap₂' ℝ D.covariance` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/SesquilinearForm.lean:163), mirroring Mathlib's bundled `ProbabilityTheory.covarianceBilin : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ`, so bilinearity comes with the definition, or add the missing lemmas explicitly, at least `variance_smul : D.variance (r • c) = r ^ 2 * D.variance c`, `variance_zero`, and additivity/homogeneity in each argument of `covarianceForm`.
findings.issue: `covarianceForm` and `variance` are bare functions with no linearity API: only `variance_add` exists. There is no `covarianceForm_add_left/right`, `covarianceForm_smul_left/right`, `variance_smul`, `variance_zero`, `covarianceForm_zero_left/right`. A consumer combining coefficient vectors (§5.4 states the variance of a determined functional "as the quadratic form of 0.1 in the coefficients", §5.5(iii) combines quadratic forms) cannot evaluate `D.variance (r • c)` or `D.covarianceForm (c + c'') c'` without unfolding through `variance_def` into `dotProduct`/`mulVec`.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:131-157: `ofTendsto` takes no hypothesis about `(F a).value`; `hasContinuumLimit_ofTendsto` supplies `hv` only at the theorem, so the definition itself admits any `v`.
findings.fix: Make `v` implicit and take the value-convergence hypothesis as an argument: `def ofTendsto {v} (hv : Tendsto (fun a => (F a).value) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v)) (hS : ...)`, updating `ofTendsto_value`, `ofTendsto_covariance` and `hasContinuumLimit_ofTendsto`; or drop the definition in favour of the existence statement `exists_hasContinuumLimit (hv) (hS) : ∃ D, HasContinuumLimit F D` together with `HasContinuumLimit.unique`.
findings.issue: `ofTendsto (v : ι → ℝ) (hS : Tendsto (fun a => (F a).covariance) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 S))` leaves `v` completely unconstrained by `F`: `ofTendsto 0 hS` typechecks and is named/documented as the continuum limit of the family while having nothing to do with its central values. The interface promises more than the signature enforces.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Probability/Moments/Variance.lean:203-204 `@[simp] theorem variance_nonneg`; Basic.lean:96-99 `@[simp] theorem comp_covariance` vs CovarianceMatrix.lean:57-61 unannotated `covarianceMatrix_comp`.
findings.issue: Missing automation annotations on two characteristic lemmas. `EuclideanDataset.variance_nonneg` is not `@[simp]` although its Mathlib counterpart is, and `covarianceMatrix_comp` (CovarianceMatrix.lean:58) is not `@[simp]` although its dataset-level mirror `comp_covariance` (Basic.lean:96) is.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:315-323 is the only functional-level limit lemma; `IsNoiseModel.integral_dotProduct` (Basic.lean:335) shows `c ⬝ᵥ D.value` is the file's central-value functional.
findings.fix: Add `HasContinuumLimit.tendsto_dotProduct_value (h : HasContinuumLimit F D) (c : ι → ℝ) : Tendsto (fun a => c ⬝ᵥ (F a).value) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (c ⬝ᵥ D.value))`, proved like `tendsto_variance` from `continuous_const.dotProduct continuous_id`.
findings.issue: The continuum-limit API develops both halves of a dataset everywhere (`tendsto_value`/`tendsto_covariance`, `comp_value`/`comp_covariance`, `ofTendsto_value`/`ofTendsto_covariance`) except at the level of a linear functional: `HasContinuumLimit.tendsto_variance` has no central-value counterpart, so a consumer of §1.4/§5.4 must redo the continuity argument to get convergence of `c ⬝ᵥ (F a).value`.

findings.evidence: grep for `exists_hasContinuumLimit|exactSubspace|restrict` in code/EpsilonEridani/QFT/Lattice: no matches.
findings.fix: Update the description to the names actually exported (it becomes the merge commit message and is how downstream work will look the API up).
findings.issue: The PR description advertises a public API that does not exist: `EuclideanDataset.restrict`, `mem_exactSubspace_iff_variance_eq_zero`, `IsNoiseModel.ae_eq_integral_iff_mem_exactSubspace`, and `exists_hasContinuumLimit`. The shipped names are `comp`, `mem_determinedSubspace_iff_variance_eq_zero`, `IsNoiseModel.ae_eq_dotProduct_value_iff_mem_determinedSubspace`, and `hasContinuumLimit_ofTendsto`.

summary: The surface is minimal and bodies are unexposed, but the characteristic API of `covarianceForm`/`variance` stops at `variance_add`: no scaling or bilinearity lemmas, so consumers must unfold to `dotProduct`/`mulVec`. `ofTendsto` also names a "limit" whose central values are unconstrained, and two annotations are missing relative to their Mathlib/in-file counterparts.
